newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates mixed on select trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates mixed on select trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates were mixed on Wednesday amid selective buying by spinners but are likely to edge up on Thursday, dealers said.
"Some of the major spinners had halted buying to bring the prices down," dealer Nasim Usman said.
But ginners resisted the move and most spinners are likely to lose patience and enter the market to buy for their immediate requirements, he said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,300 rupees ($57.18) per maund (37.32 kg) and the MHN-93 at 2,340 rupees, dealers said.
